question: Usha Barle, who won Padma Shri 2023, is popularly associated with which genre of music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandwani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandwani:**

 
 
• Pandwani is a traditional folk singing style from Chhattisgarh, India, that involves narrating tales from the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata.
 
• The word Pandwani literally translates to "stories or songs of the Pandavas."
